name: codex-coordination
description: A durable AMP v0.1 coordination ledger for Codex: strict Goal and Plan artifacts, accountable handoffs, and an append-only ledger-snapshot chain, exposed as five MCP tools and four skills.

interface.longDescription: Coordination gives Codex a durable ledger beside the repository: goals that name an observable outcome, plans of at most twelve dependency-checked tasks, handoffs between a declared owner and assignee, and an append-only chain of AMP ledger entries. Goals and plans are strict Attention Manifest Protocol v0.1 artifacts and every entry is a sha256 chain link over canonical JSON; `coordination_check` exports the ledger-snapshot and verifies it. The five MCP tools record assertions and enforce the protocol's structure; they never pretend to run your checks or prove your evidence.
defaultPrompt: Check the coordination ledger for this repository and tell me what is still open
Record this outcome as a goal with observable success criteria, then plan the steps
Audit the coordination ledger and repair anything inconsistent
